title: The failures that passed on a rerun
compared: For the first failures whose later run in the same build passed: how that run was started, and what the posted comment had said: its class, BISECT and Restart.
sample: The 67 public first failures with a hindsight label whose rerun in the same build passed on its own (one pass forced by a label is left out).

rows.answer: direct clone, no comment says who
direct clone after a mass-restart comment
direct clone by the openQA retry setting
new run of the scenario in the same build
NO, set by the same-module rule
NO, set by the streak rule

verdict: Most reruns were plain clones that no comment explains. The posted comments had called 20 of the 67 infrastructure and said Restart: YES for 28.
note: The investigation hook did retry some of these jobs, as the article says, but its clones are investigation runs and none of them is the rerun counted here.
